palette: Cream plaster, walnut wainscot in living and dining, tile in kitchen and baths, oak floors, walnut and linen furniture, brass accents, jute and mcm rugs.
notes: Every item is placed by hand in house-local metres from the approved plans, then corrected so interior reveals match the real façade windows (office west, not living west; east light at the dining/kitchen split; utility high rear; stacked attic gable lights). Origin: footprint centre, y=0 at the room floor except wall-hung pieces (y is the bottom, or the rod/rail for curtains and towels). +Z is the street (south). Kit yaw 0 faces +Z, 90 +X, 180 -Z, -90 -X. No 3D Home pin. No drafting table.
